g.text: Shelter Map - Authentication & Password Reset (auth context)
save(tokenHash : String, userId : Long, expiresAt : Instant) : void
resetPassword(email : String, code : String, newPassword : String) : void
reset(email : String, code : String, newPassword : String) : boolean
Separate aggregate from RegisteredUser (01) ON PURPOSE:
profile PII and password secrets live apart - a leak of one
table does not leak the other. Argon2id embeds the salt in
the hash string (no separate salt column). Never store or
access = JWT, 15 min, stateless, signed - the map API
refresh = 30 days, stored HASHED via RefreshTokenRepository
Reset flow (emailed 6-digit code - no URL link):
contact-change); delete the user's prior active code
3. ALWAYS respond success ("if the account exists, we sent an
email") - never reveal whether an email is registered
4. send "Shelter Map password reset code: NNNNNN (valid 15 min)"
5. reset(email, code, newPwd) -> find the account's active code,
hash new password, update UserCredentials, mark code used
6. revoke ALL refresh tokens for that user (stolen-session
protection - old sessions die on reset)
7. ONE transaction for 5+6; ANY failure (unknown email / no code /
over-limit / wrong / expired / used) -> ONE generic 400
Thin HTTP shell - zero logic, just wiring (Ch 1). Rate limiting
force and email bombing (SDI Ch 4 token bucket).
compromise): changing the email requires an SMS code sent to the
CURRENT phone; changing the phone requires an email code sent to
the CURRENT email. Stealing only one channel is not enough.
One pending change per (user, type): resend cooldown (60 s),
code TTL (15 min), 5-attempt limit, duplicate target -> 409,
per-IP rate limit on the request endpoints.
Defined in 01 (app context). Shown here with the lookup
methods the auth context requires - contracts only.
